headline: An Amazon cargo plane crashed at Miami International Airport
summary: An Amazon cargo plane overran a runway at Miami International Airport. The incident resulted in multiple injuries and vehicle damage. The FAA released a statement following the crash.

headline: Europe has its first commercial orbital rocket
summary: German company Isar Aerospace successfully launched Europe's first commercial orbital rocket. The two-stage Spectrum reached low Earth orbit from a Norwegian spaceport. This follows a previous failed attempt where the rocket crashed and exploded.

headline: Boox’s tiny Picco e-reader should land in November
summary: Boox's new Picco e-reader is expected to launch in November. Details are emerging after its IFA tease, though pricing remains undisclosed. Unlike competitors, it will not feature magnetic backing.

headline: The Fairphone 6 Plus is the midrange phone we desperately needed
summary: The Fairphone 6 Plus offers a solid midrange Android experience. It upholds Fairphone's commitment to ethical materials and high repairability. The new model significantly improves upon previous versions without sacrificing performance.

headline: [UPDATE] Halloween: The Game Patches Out Sex Minigame — Dev Confirms 'Major Oversight'
summary: Developer IllFonic patched out a sex mini-game from Halloween: The Game. The removal occurred after a gameplay clip went viral. The studio has since issued a statement acknowledging a "major oversight".

headline: The Batman Part 2 Goes in 'Another Totally Different Direction,' Robert Pattinson Teases
summary: Robert Pattinson revealed The Batman Part 2 will take a "totally different direction". He suggests a fresh take on the DC superhero. Fans can expect a distinct evolution from the first film.

headline: Zach Cregger Says He Feels Like He's 'Running for Office' Trying to Get Skeptical Resident Evil Fans 'Not to Call Me a LARPer'
summary: Resident Evil director Zach Cregger feels he's on an "apology tour." He's addressing fan skepticism about his movie adaptation. Cregger aims to convince fans he's not a "LARPer."

headline: Exodus Ending and Character Fates Change Based on Your Choices
summary: Upcoming sci-fi RPG Exodus will feature player choice-driven consequences. Decisions will impact the game's ending and character fates. The narrative director detailed how choices will be reflected.

headline: Germany's far-right AfD set for big win in eastern state, just short of majority
summary: Germany's far-right AfD party is projected for a significant win in an eastern state. They are expected to secure 44% of the vote, nearing a majority. The party has hailed this as a "historic result."

headline: Zelensky says he expects war to continue into winter after talks with US envoys
summary: President Zelensky expects the war to persist into winter. This projection follows talks with US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner. No major breakthrough was announced from the discussions.

headline: Minister to meet Jaguar Land Rover boss as thousands of job cuts expected
summary: A minister will meet with the Jaguar Land Rover boss regarding anticipated job cuts. Thousands of jobs are expected to be affected. The company faces challenges from tariffs and a prior cyber attack.

headline: BBC News presenter Maryam Moshiri reveals she has blood cancer
summary: BBC News presenter Maryam Moshiri announced her blood cancer diagnosis. She shared her condition to raise public awareness. Moshiri wanted to be open about her health journey.
